subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential/scope/subscription contract should be accepted?
rationale: Source review can prove the gap, but the remaining request changes Google Chat credential storage, consent/scopes, access to non-mentioned Space content, Pub/Sub or OAuth lifecycle, and fallback behavior.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion only behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Limit Google Chat To Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin service-account and mention-triggered, while finishing thread-reply reliability separately.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold this until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, keep service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion only behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from prior maintainer-side OAuth/security reviews and recent Google Chat/plugin-boundary history.
